name: SubjectNet
purpose: Decides whether a motion part of a sentence is about the object being moved ("the drone should rise 4 metres") or about something else ("Mia turned to her brother"), so that the motion reader keeps only the right parts.
structure: five feature groups hashed into 2048 slots of 0 or 1 → 32 hidden units (ReLU) → softmax over object and other
headline: Test 1: templates with unseen words, accuracy
Test 3: hard sentences, accuracy
Test 4: paragraphs right step by step
